verdict.rationale: Warp (HR/payroll SaaS) can be driven without its UI. It documents a REST API authenticated with API keys, typed SDKs usable from any fetch-capable runtime, and a standalone CLI binary installable via Homebrew, all of which suit headless automation. However, nothing documents CLI commands or usage in CI pipelines specifically, so headless/CI operation is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: documented CLI command reference for non-interactive use, explicit CI/pipeline guidance or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote:
standalone binary, no Node.js required
brew install TeamWarp/tap/warp
The Warp API uses API keys to authenticate requests. Include your API key in the `x-api-key` header on every request.
REST: a standard HTTPS + JSON API you can use from any language or HTTP client.
Call the API from Node.js, the browser, or any `fetch`-capable runtime with idiomatic, fully typed code.
